upstream.rights_scope: Upstream data attribution only. Source photographs are not included; no additional photographic or third-party permissions are granted.

provenance_notes: All CSV/JSON numerical values are retained. Original per-table src columns were removed; the original numerical inputs are fingerprinted below without unavailable machine paths.
Unavailable run-directory fields are omitted from prediction metadata. Archived paired image lists contain package-relative paths.
Descriptions, runtime messages and support notes are English; internal task/lab-log references are excluded.
Class order, protocol algorithms and AP formulas are retained. Full-view overlap is descriptive; cam2 alone enters training and validation.

validation.configuration_imports: all copied modules; default and relative/absolute TOMATOMAP_DATA_ROOT passed
validation.runtime_config_tests: all 8 archived split CSVs; cam2-only training/validation list counts passed
validation.paired_subset_test: 592 union-minus-train images, matched archived paired list

limitations: No images, per-image labels, detector weights, historical run trees or whole-run table aggregation script are bundled.
Code licensing requires author confirmation before public redistribution.
Environment pins are observed direct versions; clean installation and GPU retraining were not tested.
The independent T11 upstream audit requires samples.json; it was not rerun against the source dataset.
